The '''SoroSuub secure uplink station''' also abbreviated '''SUS''', was an [[uplink station]] located in an [[G'rinn Go city industrial sector|industrial sector]] of [[G'rinn Go city]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. It was one of the targets of [[Operation Thunderbolt]], as destroying it would sever the [[City/Legends|city's]] communications with the rest of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
